answer: An operator copying one text across 79 aliases thus pays for 79 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the cipher hash is stored at intake, the onyx graph groups the endorsements and the echo audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
